title: Find Leads
summary: For founders and small teams who sell to businesses: describe your customer in one sentence, approve one maximum price, and your agent returns a CRM-ready list of decision-makers whose work emails were checked the same day.
outcome: Describe your customer; get 25 decision-makers with verified work emails and why each company fits.
boundary: It finds and checks contacts only. It does not send email, add anyone to your CRM or a sequence, guess addresses or spend more than the maximum you approve. Why a company fits comes from its company data and website; it does not show that the company wants to buy now.

catalog_tools.purpose: Find up to 100 companies that match the customer description in one search.
Industry, staff count, location and description for the fit check and the why-it-matched line.
People step 1: list 10 people at the company (20 above 50 staff) with their titles; the agent picks the best title match.
People step 2: search by job title, with the work email and source pages, only when the staff list has no match.
People step 3: one person by job title, only while the provider answers, in place of step 2 when Hunter is unavailable.
Confirm a person's current role when the newest evidence is over a year old or sources disagree.
Work email for the chosen person from the staff list or Findymail, from their profile URL or name and company domain.
Second email lookup, used once when the first finds nothing.
Check each email the same day it is found: verified, catch-all or not ready.

inputs: Who you sell to, in one sentence, for example "UK accounting firms with 10 to 50 staff"

Job titles (default set by the kind and size of company and shown in the plan: Managing Partner, Partner, Director or Owner at accountants, law firms, agencies and consultancies; Owner or Founder up to 10 staff; Founder or CEO up to 50; the Head or VP of the relevant team above that)
How many contacts: 10, 25, 50 or 100 (default 25, one per company)
Optional: a CSV of customers or contacts to leave out
outputs: A summary line such as "23 of 25 ready · 19 verified · 4 catch-all · $1.41 · 9 min"
A table of contacts with a one-line reason each company fits
A CRM-ready CSV: name, title, company, website, why it matched, industry, size, city, country, email, email status, date checked and source
What could not be found and why, with a priced retry, and an offer to research the top 10 (or all, if fewer are ready) with Research My Accounts
Details at the end: how the list was built and every paid call with its run ID and cost

cost.model: You approve one maximum and pay only for calls that complete. Up to 4 company searches and company data for up to two companies per contact; then for each company a staff list, a title search only when the list has no match, an email lookup for the chosen person and one email check; a role check for at most one contact in five. After the first 10 companies, a run with fewer than 3 ready contacts pauses so you can change titles or stop. Refused calls are not charged.
cost.notes: Prices inspected 14 Oct 2026: company search $0.0025; company data $0.0067; LeadMagic staff list $0.0175 for 10 people, $0.035 for 20; Hunter title search $0.0335 for up to 10 people (billed per 10 results; $0.335 is the listed price for 100); Findymail title search $0.0278 per person; role check $0.0098; email lookup $0.0068, second lookup $0.035; email check $0.0025. One contact costs at most $0.0546 at companies of up to 50 staff ($0.0721 above 50). Maximum: 10 contacts $0.71 (the trial), 25 contacts $1.76, 50 contacts $3.51, 100 contacts $7.01 ($0.89, $2.20, $4.39 and $8.76 above 50 staff). A contact found on the first try costs $0.0335; at an 85% staff-list match and 70% email find per lookup a run averages about $0.054 per ready contact, about $1.35 for 25 and $0.54 for 10. The Skill inspects prices again before every quote.

approvals: Approve one maximum price before the first paid call
Approve again before anything that would go over it, including a retry of companies that failed
Nothing is sent and nothing is added to your CRM
compatibility: One Scrollport connection that can search, inspect and run tools and read the wallet
Somewhere to save the CSV and a small progress file, so a later run can skip people you already have
